description: If you or someone in your family is about to take possession of a flat, this one matters. In Tardeo, Mumbai, families living on the top 17 floors of a 34-storey tower had to leave their homes in August 2025, because those floors never got an occupation certificate. The High Court ordered them out and the Supreme Court did not step in. Getting the keys is not the same as getting the city's permission to live there. Did your building get its OC before people moved in?
